notes.title: Major Update 1.4.0!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
Thank you very much for purchasing Wandering Pet Garden!
We have a huge update on the core mechanics rework.
[h1]Update List[/h1]
[list]
[*] Train pets to be ready for the Release and get reward!
[*] Animations on every pets on the training activities
[*] Plant is now spawned by default and the player only needs to take care of them to get foods
[*] Improve overall visual
[*] Rework the way to acquire pets
[*] Rework the process to unlock new pet types
[/list]
Hope you can enjoy the game more with the update!

[h2]Sincerely thank you everyone for the support so far! [/h2]
[i]Sabu[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975288/11b787662d3cfc2d25464f70475e5d20f2a90b62.png[/img]
